title: pleopeltis rhomboidea
intro: Pleopeltis rhomboidea, commonly known as the rhombic polypody, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis rhomboidea include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as modulating the immune system, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the effectiveness and safety of using Pleopeltis rhomboidea for medicinal purposes.
